# TinyURL
> TinyURL is a URL shortening service for creating short links, branded links, QR codes, and link analytics.

TinyURL provides consumer and business link management tools, including custom aliases, branded domains, campaign tracking, QR codes, and developer APIs.

## Core Product
- [URL Shortener](https://tinyurl.com/): Create shortened links for easier sharing and tracking.
- [Branded Links](https://tinyurl.com/app/brand): Create short links using custom branded domains.
- [QR Codes](https://tinyurl.com/app/qr): Generate QR codes connected to shortened links and campaigns.
- [Link Analytics](https://tinyurl.com/app/analytics): Monitor clicks, engagement, and traffic performance for links.
- [Link Management](https://tinyurl.com/app): Manage, organize, and edit shortened links from the dashboard.

## Platform
- [Dashboard](https://tinyurl.com/app): Access the main workspace for managing links and campaigns.
- [Links](https://tinyurl.com/app/links): View and manage created short links in one place.
- [Campaigns](https://tinyurl.com/app/campaigns): Organize links and assets into trackable marketing campaigns.
- [Tags](https://tinyurl.com/app/tags): Categorize and filter links using tags for organization.
- [Domains](https://tinyurl.com/app/domains): Manage branded domains used for custom short links.
- [Settings](https://tinyurl.com/app/settings): Configure account, preferences, and workspace options.

## Developers
- [Developer Portal](https://tinyurl.com/developers): Entry point for TinyURL API and developer resources.
- [API Documentation](https://tinyurl.com/developers/apis): Reference for integrating TinyURL programmatically.
- [API Pricing](https://tinyurl.com/pricing/api): Compare plans and limits for API access.
- [Postman Collection](https://tinyurl.com/developers/postman): Explore and test TinyURL API endpoints in Postman.
- [OAuth and Authentication](https://tinyurl.com/developers/apis#authentication): Learn how to authenticate API requests securely.
